preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 50000.
The number of sets n in each test case must be between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= k_i <= 100000 for k_i in k_values)
preconditions.description: Each set must contain between 2 and 100000 integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_ij <= 10**9 for a_ij in all_elements)
preconditions.description: All elements in the sets must be integers between 1 and 10^9.
The total number of elements across all sets in all test cases must not exceed 200000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not similar_sets else True
postconditions.description: If no similar sets are found, output -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == f'{i} {j}' if similar_sets else False
postconditions.description: If similar sets are found, output their indices i and j.
